text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty fired: service=inference-prod, severity=high, symptom=5xx-spike, region=us-west1
incident-bot: Alert link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/P12345 :rotating_light:
Jordan M: acking — I'm on it. Pulling up runbook now.
Priya S: noted. On standby to take handoff after initial triage.
Jordan M: quick check — is this customer impact or internal traffic? Initial dashboards show 20% of requests returning 500s, 6-min moving avg latency spike.
Chris L: @Jordan M can you paste the failing stacktrace / error? I saw KV cache errors earlier on the infra dashboard.
Jordan M: grabbing logs.```
[2024-08-20T15:02:10Z] inference-runtime: worker-43 ERROR: model_infer: UnhandledException: CUDA out_of_memory while allocating KV cache
[2024-08-20T15:02:11Z] frontend-gateway WARN: retrying request id=abc123 status=500
```
OpsOncall: interesting — OOMs usually after a config rollover. Any deploys in last 30m?
Priya S: I can confirm no production deploys in the last hour. Autoscaler did scale up GPU pool ~12m ago.
Jordan M: rolling back autoscale step? I think some newly added batch-size heuristic pushed sequences above expected and increased mem. Temporarily scaling down batch size on the model route.
Chris L: good call. Jordan, can you run this curl to change route config? ```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/routes/inference-prod/config -d '{"batch_size":8}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
Jordan M: applied batch_size=8 to route. Observability: token-level memory dropping, OOMs stopped. 5xx rate falling: 20% -> 3% in 90s :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by Jordan M
Priya S: starting customer impact assessment — looking at top affected customers. Two enterprise tenants saw errors on a small fraction of calls (<0.5% of their total traffic) — reaching out via support to flag.
Jordan M: plan: keep batch_size=8 for 15m, monitor KV cache usage, then test safe ramp to previous value in staging. If stable, can plan controlled bump.
SRE-Lead: Jordan, please handoff to Priya after 15m. Priya, if anything regresses, escalate to oncall rotation for dedicated-capacity.
Priya S: acknowledged, will take over at 1748130900
Jordan M: handing off — summary: root cause suspected autoscaler + batch heuristic caused OOMs; mitigated by reducing batch_size; customer impact low but customers notified; continuing monitoring. :white_check_mark:
OpsOncall: thanks. I'll update the incident tracker with timeline and link to logs.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation stopped. Next steps: document config change, reopen if reoccurs. :memo:
Priya S: taking final ownership for stabilization window. Pinging if any alerts re-fire. :eyes:
